info.name: PropMS Mobile & API (Full)
info.description:
# PropMS API — Full Collection

Whitelisted endpoints under `propms/api` (**201** methods).

## Base URL
`{{base_url}}` = `https://dev15-viva2.vvsdtz.com`

## Call style
```
POST|GET {{base_url}}/api/method/<method.path>
```
Response envelope: `{ "message": { ... } }`.

## Auth (Frappe session)
1. Set collection variables `usr` and `pwd` (e.g. `Administrator` or a tenant user).
2. Run **00. Session Login → Login**.
3. Postman keeps the `sid` cookie for later requests — no API key needed.
4. To test as another user: change `usr`/`pwd`, run **Logout**, then **Login** again.

## Prefer mobile wrappers
Flutter should use `propms.api.mobile.*` (and some `propms.api.*`).  
Each domain has a **Direct v1** subfolder for underlying handlers.

## Domains
Auth, POS Store Services (Maintenance POS), Electricity (POS), Drinking Water Cart (DEPRECATED), Selcom Payments, Invoices, Tickets/Job Cards, Gate Pass, Amenities, Emergency, Directory, Calls, Files, Notifications.

**POS Store hub** is curated in Desk: **Mobile App Settings → POS Store Services** (Item+qty or Special+amount). Prefer **02c**. Do not use Item checkbox `show_in_mobile_pos_store` (removed).

## Guest endpoints
- `propms.api.mobile.request_password_reset_otp`
- `propms.api.mobile.verify_otp`
- `propms.api.mobile.reset_password_after_otp`
- `propms.api.mobile.verify_otp_and_reset_password`
- `propms.api.mobile.get_payment_methods`
- `propms.api.mobile.selcom_ipn_webhook`
- `propms.api.v1.invoices.invoices.selcom_payment_webhook`
- `propms.api.v1.payments.services.get_payment_methods`
- `propms.api.v1.payments.webhook.selcom_ipn_webhook`

## Publish (NextSMS-style docs)
Postman → collection **…** → **View Documentation** / **Publish Docs** → public  
`https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/...`

item.name: 02b. Electricity Purchase (POS)
item.description:
**Electricity** — amount + TANESCO/Generator split → Selcom (`electricity_pos`) → **Paid POS Sales Invoice**.

Flow: `get_electricity_rates` → `preview_electricity_purchase` → `checkout_electricity` (or `pay_electricity_with_stored_card`) → `get_payment_status`.

**No unpaid SI before pay.** `create_electricity_invoice` is deprecated.

Prefer **Mobile / App wrappers**.

item.name: 02c. POS Store Services (Maintenance POS)
item.description:
Hub from **Mobile App Settings → POS Store Services** (child table: Item+qty or Special+amount).

Flow: `get_pos_store_catalog` → `services[]` → product detail (`get_pos_store_item`) → `checkout_pos_item` / `pay_pos_item_with_stored_card` → Selcom → Paid POS SI (`maintenance_pos`).

- Prefer `message.services` (ordered). Also returns `items[]` (qty) and `special_services[]` (e.g. electricity).
- `purchase_mode=qty` → checkout_pos_item. `purchase_mode=amount` + `special_key=electricity` → **02b** electricity APIs (not checkout_pos_item).
- `image` is Item.image path (e.g. `/files/kisimab.png`); app builds `{{base_url}}` + path.
- No Sales Order. Water cart (**02**) is DEPRECATED.
